items.content_html: Shop Minis Playground is a sandbox project to explore Shopify’s Shop Minis SDK. It focuses on learning how to build interactive, lightweight Mini apps that enhance the Shop app experience using React. The project experiments with SDK features, UI components, and Shopify data integration to create engaging in-app shopping experiences.

items.content_html: Neura Testnet Client is a lightweight TypeScript client for interacting with Neura Testnet (an EVM-compatible network).
